goal: Finish the deferred 11520 mobile immersive-operation package after the prior oracle/character-tap project closed: maximize usable mobile viewport, repair fullscreen behavior with standards-based browser fullscreen plus a fail-open visible-viewport fallback, keep existing HUD collapse ownership, and make LONG/SHORT direction directly operable on the active K-axis without bypassing the existing order confirmation path.

immersive_viewport: Request Fullscreen API with navigationUI=hide when the host browser supports it and user activation permits it.
Use VisualViewport height to consume the actually visible viewport.
Provide an explicit viewport-fallback mode when browser or in-app browser fullscreen is unavailable or rejected.
Keep an explicit exit affordance in immersive mode.
Do not claim control of unsupported Android system navigation bars or host-app browser chrome.
direct_direction_selection: Show 多 LONG and 空 SHORT controls only on the currently active K-axis card.
Synchronize the selection through the existing canonical trade side control rather than creating parallel trading state.
Direction selection alone MUST NOT execute an order.
Existing order preview/confirmation remains mandatory and unchanged.
existing_layout_ownership: Preserve Mobile Control Layout as the sole coordinate/layout owner.
Preserve the existing global HUD collapse and utility controls; do not add a second collapse system.
Preserve XZ+Y / XY+Z / YZ+X controller semantics and Normal Market Presentation semantics.

machine_verifiable_acceptance: 390x844 real Chromium entry loads without page errors.
Active K-axis exposes exactly one visible direct direction picker with LONG and SHORT.
SHORT selection updates the existing canonical trade side to 空 while leaving the sheet closed.
LONG selection updates the existing canonical trade side to 多 while leaving the sheet closed.
Switching K-axis keeps exactly one visible direct direction picker.
Fallback immersive mode consumes the VisualViewport height, sets an explicit mode, exposes an exit control and synchronizes the settings switch.
Required screenshot artifacts/11520-visual-qa/11520-mobile-immersive-trading.png exists and is non-empty.
Existing 11520 Game Product QA screenshot gates remain mandatory.
browser_boundary: A normal web page can request standards-based fullscreen and can size itself to the visible viewport, but it cannot force every Facebook/in-app browser or Android system navigation UI to disappear. Unsupported hosts therefore fail open to visible-viewport immersive mode rather than pretending the OS/browser chrome was removed.
merge_policy: Merge only from the exact reviewed head after required PR checks are green; then verify the exact merged main SHA with Game Product QA, Responsive Product QA, Universal Exchange V2, and Pages deployment.
